segments.text: Ok so this is the Surfaces page for Google ADK, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page has this product row fallback but no ADK backend anywhere, uh, only frontend.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Product and Product Row were never defined on the page, so I added small stubs myself.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for running shoes, it should show a product surface, but the agent can't see any products, just text.
So basically there's no ADK backend code for surfaces, so nothing gets rendered.
That's it for this one, kindly look into this issue.
